name: @lubusin/wp-frappe-data-store
description: A @wordpress/data store for querying and mutating Frappe resources.

scripts.docs:dev: npm run docs:generate && vitepress dev docs
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:generate && vitepress build docs
scripts.dev:app: npm run build && cd ../wpui-frappe-app-starter && npm run dev
scripts.playground: npm run build && cd ../wpui-frappe-plugin-starter && npm run build && npm run playground
scripts.link:starters: npm link && cd ../wpui-frappe-app-starter && npm link @lubusin/wp-frappe-data-store && cd ../wpui-frappe-plugin-starter && npm link @lubusin/wp-frappe-data-store
